h13.

**`*markdown.service` (the sole, unexported impl) — built by `markdown.NewService(...)` in `NewAPIV1Service` — held by `APIV1Service`, `rss.RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner`.**

### The interface
`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` — `markdown.Service` (8 methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`).

### Concrete implementation
There is exactly one: the unexported `service` struct wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60`, methods at lines 143, 193, 244, 255, 264, 349, 356, 425). No mocks/fakes/alternate impls exist — tests use the real one. Its behavior is varied by options rather than by type: `WithTagExtension()` / `WithMentionExtension()` (`markdown.go:71-82`) plug in `extensions.TagExtension` / `extensions.MentionExtension` on top of `extension.GFM`.

Internally it delegates markdown-to-markdown output to a second concrete type, `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`), constructed per call at `markdown.go:250` and `markdown.go:451`.

### Construction (production path)
Only one production construction site: `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, with both tag and mention extensions enabled. That single instance is then shared — `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService`.

Other `markdown.NewService(...)` calls are test-only: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`, plus `internal/markdown/markdown_test.go`.

### Holders of the interface
| Holder | Field | Runtime use |
|---|---|---|
| `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`) | `MarkdownService` | `ExtractAll` for mentions (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), `GenerateSnippet` for webhooks (`memo_service_webhooks.go:85`), and passed to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`memo_service.go:108`, `:447`) |
| `rss.RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`) | `MarkdownService` | `RenderHTML` for feed items (`rss.go:339`) |
| `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`) | `MarkdownService` | `RunOnce` → `RebuildMemoPayload` → `ExtractAll` (`runner.go:80`) |

One caveat worth flagging: `memopayload.NewRunner` (`runner.go:19`) has **no caller** anywhere in the repo, including tests — so `Runner` holds the interface in the type definition but never executes at runtime. The live path into that package is the free function `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, markdownService)`, which takes `markdown.Service` as a parameter (`runner.go:74`) and is called by `APIV1Service`.

Note that HTML rendering for the UI is *not* on this path — per the doc comment at `markdown.go:29-30`, the frontend renders with markdown-it; the Go `RenderHTML` exists for RSS and other server-side rendering.
